name: Finding the Golden Key
hint_layers: Start by treating ordinary furniture as searchable, not just decorative.
The bed has an object that can be lifted or moved.
solution: Lift the pillow on the bed to reveal and collect the golden key.

name: Unlocking the Drawer for the Power Cord
hint_layers: A found key usually belongs to a nearby lock rather than the exit door.
Inspect the desk drawers after obtaining the key.
Use the golden key on the locked drawer.
solution: Use the golden key on the previously locked desk drawer, then collect the power cord inside.

name: Powering the Stereo
hint_layers: The device on the desk is not usable until it has power.
Use the newly found cord with the device on top of the desk.
After connecting the cord, turn the stereo on.
solution: Use the power cord on the stereo on top of the desk, then click the stereo's power button.

name: Escaping Through the Door
hint_layers: The exit is not opened by simply turning the knob.
The final tool interacts with the door hardware rather than the keyhole.
Use the screwdriver on the door's doorknob.
solution: After solving the room's puzzles and collecting the screwdriver, use it on the locked door's doorknob to escape.
